random_stream: numpy SeedSequence([scenario_index, seed]); independent per scenario
statistical_rule: ordinary paired percentile bootstrap of run differences, 10000 replicates, upper=0.95 quantile; each force metric upper <=0 both per scenario and in the equal-scenario-weight pooled estimate; nonsignificance is not acceptance
force_comparator: full versus baseline, same scenario/seed/initial state/exogenous disturbances
force_metric_interval: all active scan samples after initial confirmed contact until actual scan completion or fixed timeout; include pauses and transients, exclude precontact seek
failure_handling: all manifest runs required; solver failure, missing/invalid data or timeout prevents acceptance and is reported; never drop failed pairs or replace with a different seed
pooling: uniform scenario weights, uniform seeds within scenario; resample paired seeds within each scenario then average scenario means
quality_truth: synthetic physical coupling fraction >=0.90 in BOTH required aperture windows; center ignored; this independent plant truth is NOT the controller confidence score

quality_metrics.bad_path_m: measured forward path distance without both required windows valid; unscanned remainder is also missing coverage
quality_metrics.valid_coverage_fraction: valid measured forward path union / total path length
quality_metrics.valid_coverage_rate_m_s: valid measured forward path union / total scan elapsed time

quality_acceptance: full versus each comparator: paired upper95(delta bad_path)<0 and lower95(delta valid_coverage_rate)>=0, pooled over repairable scenarios; all full repairable runs must finish before 4*T+12, and valid coverage fraction must not decrease in any repairable scenario mean
matched_control_rule: paired baseline law retains its signs/state; matched_scan_speed reuses full run accepted alpha schedule by path coordinate; matched_rocking uses full run absolute angular-speed envelope by path coordinate, clips baseline angular request without changing its sign; full and all comparators use identical force limits and disturbances
